CYBERWATCH_GROUP.description: Optional Cyberwatch group name to filter the asset inventory (forwarded as the 'group' query parameter on /api/v3/assets). Omit to pull every asset visible to the API key.

CYBERWATCH_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Minimum Faraday severity bucket to import. Valid values: info, low, medium, high, critical. Forwarded to /api/v3/vulnerabilities as 'min_severity' and additionally enforced client-side after severity normalisation (handles both Cyberwatch's level_* strings and CVSS numeric scores). Default: info.

name: cyberwatch
title: Cyberwatch
description: Cyberwatch (Vulnerability Manager / Compliance Manager) importer. Lists assets via /api/v3/assets (optionally filtered by group) and per-asset vulnerabilities via /api/v3/vulnerabilities; emits one Faraday host per Cyberwatch asset. Severity is normalised from Cyberwatch's level_* strings (level_critical/high/medium/low/negligible) or, when only a CVSS score is provided, bucketed via the CVSS v3 ranges. Auth uses the IETF HTTP Signatures draft (HMAC-SHA256 over '(request-target) host date accept') — set CYBERWATCH_API_KEY as the signature keyId, CYBERWATCH_SECRET_KEY as the signing secret, and CYBERWATCH_HOST to the Cyberwatch master base URL.
